text: About one in seven people has migraine, women about three times as often as men.
According to the WHO, migraine is among the conditions that limit people's everyday lives the most worldwide.
There is migraine without any headache: in vestibular migraine, dizziness takes centre stage.
Children sometimes have abdominal migraine: tummy pain and nausea instead of a headache.
Migraine often runs in families. Many genes each add a small part.
An attack can start up to two days before the pain, for example with yawning or cravings.
An aura can affect all senses: sight, touch, speech, more rarely hearing or smell.
After an attack, many people feel hungover. This phase can last up to two days.
An aura usually lasts from a few minutes to an hour. If several symptoms come, they usually come one after another.
Acute medication usually works best when taken early in an attack.
The 10-day rule counts days, not tablets: three tablets on one day are one day.
If the first triptan dose does not help at all, a second one in the same attack usually won't either.
Too many pain relievers can cause headaches themselves. This is called medication overuse headache.
A preventive already counts as a success if it roughly halves your migraine days.
Whether a preventive works usually shows only after two to three months.
CGRP antibodies are the first medications developed specifically against migraine.
Many classic preventives come from very different fields, such as high blood pressure or epilepsy.
Many women get migraine around their period, probably because of the drop in oestrogen.
Only very few women get migraine exclusively around their period.
From about three attacks a month, it is worth talking about prevention.
An attack lasting longer than 72 hours is called status migrainosus and needs a doctor.
In Germany, 116 117 reaches the out-of-hours medical service around the clock.
Severe migraine can be recognised as a disability. From a degree of 50 there is a severe disability card.
The migraine brain gets used to stimuli less. A sound stays loud even the tenth time.
Many triggers are really changes: getting up later, skipping a meal, stress that eases.
Some weekend migraines happen because sleep, meals and coffee come later than on weekdays.
Migraine and depression are linked both ways. That is not weakness but partly the same biology.
With migraine, the thyroid is worth a look. An underactive thyroid can be checked with a blood test.
Craving chocolate is often already a warning sign. The chocolate is innocent.
In a survey from Münster, a good half said that sex during an attack eased the pain.
Hildegard of Bingen's visions are often read today as migraine aura.
For many women, migraine becomes much rarer after menopause.
Ketone bodies are a second energy source for the brain. That is the idea behind the ketogenic diet.
High-dose vitamin B2 turns urine bright yellow. That is harmless.
Magnesium, vitamin B2 and Q10 are meant to support the energy supply of nerve cells. That is why they are used for prevention.
Feverfew should not be stopped suddenly, or headaches and joint pain can follow.
Caffeine makes pain relievers work better. That is why it is in some combination products.
Caffeine withdrawal can cause headaches itself when the body is used to a lot of coffee.
In studies, acupuncture at the "wrong" points worked almost as well as at the right ones.
Some dogs seem to sense an attack before their people notice anything.
